skills-buffs-status.notes: Every level-up and reroll performs an original-style weighted draw without replacement, filtering by times, used-hero range, account hero star, recovered wave conditions, and current base HP. RG_ALL_abl10_eff01 upgrades one random placed non-power gear. RG_ALL_abl07_eff01 multiplies later EXP notifications by 1.5. RG_ALL_abl08_eff01 applies live enemy ATK_DEC. RG_ALL_abl12_eff01 gives future HAMSTER/WHEEL outputs from directly adjacent core gears a 1.2 attack multiplier. RG_ALL_abl16_eff01 gives the same direct-neighbor scope 1.2 worker progress and displayed rate. RG_ALL_abl17_eff01 is a noRestore immediate consumable available at 0%-50% base HP; it heals floor(max HP * 0.5), clamps to max, and does not persist in the trait stack. RG_ALL_abl18_eff01 is a one-time persistent ability available at 0%-75% base HP; it does not heal on selection and restores floor(max HP * 0.1), capped to max, on every later BAGLIKE_BATTLE_ROUND_START.
